title: TutorialCore: Troubleshooting
summary: Diagnose common TutorialCore failures by shrinking the loop and testing one fix.

blocks.title: Common Failure
blocks.body: If help feels quiet, check that TutorialCore is loaded and that the expected addon is present for the action you are trying.

blocks.title: Reset The Loop
blocks.body: If help feels quiet, confirm TutorialCore is loaded, perform the related action, check whether the owning addon is present, and look for existing cards before forcing progress.

blocks.title: One Fix At A Time
blocks.body: Change one variable, run a smaller test, and compare the result. Fixing three things at once can hide the part that actually mattered.

blocks.title: Retest Cleanly
blocks.body: Change one variable, test on a smaller route, and keep the fix only if the failure becomes easier to explain.
